integrity: Exact algebraic proof and parameter-uniform inequalities; high-precision tests are supplementary and not independent validation. A published prior census supplies the existence count but explicitly did not establish two-cycle stability. Publication priority subject to unindexed equivalent sources.
limitations: The theorem covers the real plane with positive forcing and 0<beta<=2. It gives a sharp parameter-only criterion for whether any exponentially attracting primitive two-cycle can occur, not a complete sink window below beta=3/2, nor higher periods or global basins.
title: The sharp three-halves two-cycle stability barrier in a cosine–memristor map
